governing_outcome: In native ChatGPT sessions, the Agent—not the user—must carry the routine responsibility to assess the required execution depth on every selected-context turn, proactively escalating to current UAOS DeepTask/cognition/evolution mechanisms when warranted, while simple tasks remain lightweight and repository authority remains singular.
raw_evidence: config/SESSION_INTERACTION_POLICY.json currently defines always-on problem detection but no equally explicit every-turn non-problem execution-depth sentinel.

docs/integration/CHATGPT_CUSTOM_INSTRUCTIONS.md currently activates canonical cognition for problems/corrections/knowledge gaps but does not explicitly require independent DeepTask semantic assessment on every request.

src/uaos/kernel/deep_task.py already defines semantic DeepTaskSignals and non-explicit material escalation; the kernel therefore exposes the required mechanism but the native ChatGPT session/bootstrap path does not explicitly own invocation responsibility.

CURRENT_SYSTEM.json explicitly records NATIVE_CHATGPT_PRE_SEND_AND_PRE_TOOL_MEDIATION_REMAINS_UNVERIFIED, so the repair must improve behavioral invocation without making a physical non-bypassability claim.
professional_method_evidence: OpenAI Help Center states Custom Instructions are direct guidance applied across chats; this supports using them as a persistent compact bootstrap/activation pointer.

OpenAI Help Center states Memory selects relevant context rather than searching/using every historical detail on every response; this supports not relying on Memory alone for the control-plane bootstrap.
UAOS's existing single-owner cognition architecture requires session/host surfaces to activate canonical mechanisms rather than copy their detailed semantics.

architecture_candidates.falsification: Would only be acceptable if current native-session bootstrap already required independent every-turn non-problem depth classification; repository evidence shows it does not.
Would only be acceptable if duplication could not drift from repository authority; the repository explicitly treats Custom Instructions as non-authoritative bootstrap-only.
Would only be necessary if DeepTask semantic activation did not already exist; src/uaos/kernel/deep_task.py already provides it.
Reject if it requires duplicating DeepTask semantics, increases simple-task cost materially, or cannot preserve the native-host assurance boundary.

independent_judge_plan: Repository contract tests will require the session policy to state every-turn self-classification and the Custom Instructions pointer to state user-independent depth assessment.
Tests will also reject detailed A-H duplication in the Custom Instructions pointer and retain explicit native-host non-bypassability limits.
PR CI/promotion-gate will be the independent repository judge before production promotion.
acceptance_criteria: Every selected-context request is independently assessed for execution depth, even when the user does not label the task.
Explicit deeper-not-larger wording remains a mandatory override but is not the sole trigger.
Problem detection and execution-depth routing stay separate lightweight sentinels feeding the same canonical cognition/deep-task authority.
Custom Instructions stay compact and non-authoritative.
No physical complete-mediation claim is added for native ChatGPT.
Candidate CI and production reread pass.
next_action: Implement and test the preferred architecture on the candidate branch, then promote only if checks and production reread succeed.
